derivedLayout.formatPrefsRuntimeJoin: The exact reader transfers the three consecutive u32 fields in serialized order and stores them at title runtime +0x18, +0x20, and +0x1C respectively. The exact writer reads those same runtime locations in the same serialized order.
derivedLayout.blockBoundary: The last derived transfer is the one-byte Persist Render Data field. RVA-F-0124 independently proves exact bounded consumption for all 383 accepted source blocks.

sourceSelectionContract.externalPath: Use External equal to one identifies File Name as the supported external source carrier. RVA-F-0124 proves 383 such records, each with a valid non-null string-table index and a null Pixel Data reference.
sourceSelectionContract.supportedExternalRequirement: Studio may classify a retained record as a supported external source only when Use External equals one, File Name is a valid non-null string-table index, and Pixel Data is the standard null reference. A different structurally retained combination must remain explicitly unsupported rather than being silently interpreted as this observed external path.
sourceSelectionContract.embeddedAlternative: Use External equal to zero selects the schema-defined embedded-source alternative through Pixel Data. Both File Name and Pixel Data fields still occupy their listed profile positions, but the bounded observation set contains no embedded positive and this packet does not decode the target payload.
sourceSelectionContract.referenceValidation: A read-only parser must validate File Name as either the standard null value or an in-range string-table index and Pixel Data as either the standard null reference or an in-range block index before resolving either carrier. Target payload decoding is not implied by index validity.
sourceSelectionContract.privacy: The aggregate establishes index validity and nullness only. No filename text, pixel data, payload bytes, hash, archive-relative name, or per-file identifier is retained.

titleReadWriteBehavior.reader: Reader 0x82391BA8 consumes all nine derived fields in order after its inherited call. The three u32 preferences are stored without arithmetic. Is Static, Direct Render, and Persist Render Data are normalized to zero or one in ordinary title runtime state.
titleReadWriteBehavior.writer: Writer 0x82391FF0 emits the same 24-byte profile order. It reconstructs Use External as one only when both of its runtime pixel-data carriers are null, emits File Name, chooses one runtime pixel-data carrier according to Persist Render Data, then emits the three u32 preferences and the three stored trailing bytes. On an ordinary read-then-write path, those trailing bytes have already been normalized by the reader.
titleReadWriteBehavior.rawPreservation: The exact serialized widths and order are proved, but the ordinary title object is not a lossless carrier for raw Use External or the three trailing byte values because it derives or normalizes them. The three FormatPrefs u32 values are transferred without arithmetic or reordering.
titleReadWriteBehavior.qualification: The writer's runtime carrier choice is evidence about title serialization only. It does not prove resource lookup, persistence behavior, direct-render behavior, pixel ownership, or renderer use.

profileConditions.currentProfile: At 20.3.0.9 all nine listed fields are present. File Name and Pixel Data each have a profile branch covering both Use External values, so the byte shape does not change between external and embedded records at this version.
profileConditions.olderVersions: The exact reader contains older-version branches for string representation and trailing controls. They are outside the accepted profile and are not promoted.
profileConditions.noAdditionalFields: The current-profile title reader and writer transfer no presence byte, Flags field, alignment pad, extra format preference, or derived field after Persist Render Data.

implementationContract.supported: Studio may retain the raw Use External byte, validated File Name string index, raw Pixel Data reference, ordered Pixel Layout/Use Mipmaps/Alpha Format u32 values, and raw Is Static/Direct Render/Persist Render Data bytes from a bounded 20.3.0.9 NiSourceTexture block.
implementationContract.requiredBoundary: Retention remains read-only and block-bounded. Preserve original field values and source order; validate indices before resolution; require exact block consumption; expose the observed external filename relationship only when Use External equals one, the filename index is valid and non-null, and Pixel Data is the standard null reference; keep a non-null embedded target opaque.
implementationContract.excluded: External path resolution, filesystem search, texture loading, NiPixelData decoding, DDS conversion, GPU upload, sampling, mip behavior, alpha interpretation, direct-render interpretation, persistence policy, shader interaction, rendering, editing, conversion, export, and writing remain outside this contract.

entries.result: The live title string and initializer bind NiSourceTexture to descriptor 0x82F8E570 and exact NiTexture parent descriptor 0x82F8E66C.
The anchored method table and bounded bodies establish the inherited-first reader/writer pair and complete 24-byte current-profile derived order.
The direct NiTexture thunks resolve to the NiObjectNET reader/writer pair; NiTexture adds no profile field before Use External.
The accepted privacy-preserving observation proves 383 external records with valid non-null filename indices, null pixel-data references, and exact block consumption.

currentEvidence.privacy: No retail filename, texture value, identifier, hash, payload, byte sample, archive-relative name, or per-file fact was read, retained, or written. Only title executable metadata, pinned schema declarations, and accepted aggregate facts were used.

boundedNegatives: No title default or initialization behavior for these fields is promoted beyond the directly observed reader normalization and writer derivation.
No embedded NiSourceTexture positive occurs in the accepted observation set, so NiPixelData and NiPersistentSrcTextureRendererData payloads remain unresolved and undecoded.
No valid enum range or semantic behavior is promoted for Pixel Layout, Use Mipmaps, or Alpha Format.
No title or schema evidence in this packet establishes path normalization, path root, case policy, fallback search, companion-file existence, or runtime acceptance.
No renderer behavior is promoted for Is Static, Direct Render, or Persist Render Data; the exact labels identify serialized fields only.
The ordinary title object derives or normalizes four byte fields, so title-runtime state must not be described as preserving their original nonzero byte values.

conclusion: NiSourceTexture's exact title reader 0x82391BA8 and writer 0x82391FF0 consume the NiTexture/NiObjectNET payload first, then the accepted profile's packed 24-byte derived sequence: Use External, File Name index, Pixel Data reference, Pixel Layout, Use Mipmaps, Alpha Format, Is Static, Direct Render, and Persist Render Data. Both source-carrier fields occupy fixed positions for either Use External value at 20.3.0.9. RVA-F-0124 independently proves 383 external positives with valid non-null filename indices and null pixel-data references. Raw read-only field retention is implementation-ready; external resource lookup, embedded pixel decoding, enum semantics, renderer behavior, and runtime acceptance remain unresolved.
